notes: 3-methylcyclohexanone correct; traps, why, 2-step mechanism (1,4-add, C-protonation) fine. Simplified carbanion-adds key step is the standard textbook depiction; review note resolved and removed.
1,2-addition to tertiary allylic alcohol correct; traps, retro distractors (cuprate 1,4; allylic alcohol + RMgBr) and mechanism fine.
n-BuLi 1,2-addition to cyclopentenone correct; traps/retro/mechanism fine.

Acetophenone from PhCOCl + Me2CuLi correct; methyl benzoate + cuprate distractor is valid (cuprates do not react with esters per Klein/Wade). Simplified add-eliminate mechanism acceptable; review removed.
Propylbenzene correct; E2/homocoupling/rearrangement traps fair; retro (RMgBr + RX, FC with 1-chloropropane) genuinely fail. SN2-looking key step is the usual simplification; review removed.
3-hydroxybutanal at 5 °C vs condensation with heat is the standard textbook split; mechanism and pKa note fine. Review removed.
Mono-bromination of acetophenone in AcOH correct; 4-step acid enol mechanism correct; traps accurate.

Benzoic acid + CHI3; 10-step mechanism checked (3 enolate iodinations, OH- addition, CI3- expulsion, proton transfer, workup). Key step choice fine; review removed. 'Br2, NaOH' alias kept since it gives the same acid.
LDA/-78 °C on 2-methylcyclohexanone gives 2,6-dimethylcyclohexanone; traps and retro distractors correct.
Product 2,2-dimethylcyclohexanone is the textbook answer, but NaOEt/EtOH then CH3I is course-dependent (polyalkylation, 2,6-product, ethoxide + CH3I Williamson). Review note kept and extended.
2-propylcyclohexanone correct; traps, retro (Grignard; alcohol can't be alkylating agent) and mechanism fine.

Product 2-methylpent-2-enal and 5-step E1cB mechanism correct. Removed bare 'NaOH' alias, which would accept the no-heat conditions that the paired aldol-addition card says stop at the β-hydroxy aldehyde.
Chalcone correct; crossed/self-condensation traps and retro distractors (cinnamaldehyde; cinnamoyl chloride + PhMgBr) fine; mechanism fine.
3-methylcyclopent-2-enone correct; ring-size and regiochemistry traps accurate; mechanism fine.
Ethyl acetoacetate; 5-step mechanism incl. driving deprotonation (pKa ~11) and workup correct; traps/retro fine.
Ethyl 2-oxocyclopentanecarboxylate correct; ring-size and regiochemistry traps accurate; mechanism fine.
Benzoylacetone from ethyl benzoate + acetone/NaOEt is a standard crossed Claisen; diketo depiction is acceptable convention; mechanism and pKa ~9 fine. Review removed.
Michael adduct correct; traps (1,2, wrong carbon, decarboxylated) and retro (heat workup, crotonaldehyde) genuinely fail; mechanism fine.
Octalone (4,4a,5,6,7,8-hexahydronaphthalen-2(3H)-one) correct; 8-step Michael/aldol/E1cB mechanism with EtOH/EtO- proton shuttles checked; retro distractors fail as stated. Review removed.

Butanoic acid and 11-step mechanism (alkylation, parallel acid hydrolysis, cyclic decarboxylation, tautomerization) correct. Removed alias 'NaOEt, EtBr', which omits the hydrolysis/decarboxylation step and would accept an answer giving diethyl ethylmalonate. Review removed.
2-Pentanone and 11-step mechanism correct. Removed alias 'NaOEt, EtBr' (gives the alkylated β-keto ester, not the ketone).

Key step had wrong electron bookkeeping (OH lone pair to C=O with H still on O; ketone O ended as an anion, no H transfer). Made the acid H explicit ([H:30]) in the reactant and replaced the key step with the proper 4-arrow cyclic TS (ketone O takes H). Review removed.
2-Allylcyclohexanone; 12-step enamine formation/alkylation/hydrolysis mechanism checked; traps and retro fine. H3O+/H2O as proton shuttles acceptable; review removed.
